title: Sidebar: compact density
note: 28px rows, 36px tiles, 4px content inset.

note: 56px rail: icon favorites, favicon-only tabs, vertical workspace dots.

title: Sidebar: auto-hide, peeking
note: Sidebar hidden; floating peek panel over the page from the edge hot zone.

title: Sidebar: on the right
note: Everything mirrored; window controls stay at the outer edge.

title: Sidebar: command bar
note: Centred bar over a dimmed page with workspace, tab and archive results.

title: Sidebar: tab context menu
note: Pin, Rename, Add to Favorites, Move to workspace, Sleep now, Close.

title: Sidebar: archive panel
note: Archive panel: header with the auto-archive setting ("Archive Today tabs after 12 hours"), search, rows grouped by Today / Yesterday / Last week, each with a Workspace label; click a row to restore it.

title: Sidebar: focus order overlay
note: Numbered badges for tab and screen-reader order.

title: Sidebar: Guard popover
note: Stub popover from the address pill: Guard panel, see Guard design.

title: Folders: auto-file toast
note: A new tab matching the Trips rules was filed into the Trips folder (funnel glyph on the row). Toast: Filed into Trips, Undo, Don't file this site.

title: Folders: smart folder
note: Smart folder 'Northwind docs' (dashed sparkle glyph, italic count) lists matching tabs from Pinned and Today without moving them. The hovered row shows where it lives (Today).

title: Folders: smart folder tooltip
note: Tooltip on a smart folder: it is a live view, its rules, closing a tab here closes the real tab.

title: Folders: editor, auto-file
note: Sheet anchored to the sidebar: name and icon, kind, rules as chips (one rule off), exception list, behaviour toggles (sleep after 30 minutes set; others show Inherits global).

title: Folders: editor, smart
note: Smart folders have rules but no behaviour section; the sheet says how many tabs match now.

title: Folders: editor, rules off
note: All of the folder's rules are off: the rule glyph on the row is struck through, the sheet shows a banner, rows are dimmed, the list is kept.

title: Tabs: renamed tooltip
note: A renamed tab has a small pencil marker. The tooltip shows the real page title, the precedence list (your name wins) and Reset name.

title: Tabs: tidied title tooltip
note: '(3) Inbox - Fjord Mail' shows as 'Inbox'. Tooltip: Tidied, original title, and the five-step precedence.

title: Tabs: archive after archiving
note: After Archive now: the Today tab is gone and sits at the top of the Today group in the archive (the fly-to-button animation runs from the mockup control Archive now).

title: Tabs: sleeping summary in Today
note: Hovering the Today header shows '3 asleep · ~410 MB freed' (estimate).
